purpose: SEC-DB-RLS-001 phase 2: every database call site that behaves differently under a non-superuser, non-owner, RLS-enforced runtime role. A ratchet validator (scripts/validate-sec-db-call-sites.cjs) fails when a new unclassified site appears.

classes.A: cross-tenant discovery or aggregation through a client with no tenant context: silently sees only the default tenant under RLS
classes.A2: cross-tenant raw scan that uses tenant() with no argument: silently default tenant only
classes.B: tenant is known but the direct (no-context) client is used: writes fail loudly under RLS, reads return empty
classes.C: pre-tenant bootstrap or platform lookups needing an explicit decision
classes.R: request-scoped raw SQL through tenant() with no argument: correct only while the request tenant equals the filter tenant

remediations.tenant-iteration: default: iterate tenants from the authoritative directory and act inside each tenant's own context (runWithTenantContext or prisma.tenant(key))
remediations.maintenance-read: narrow exception: a SELECT-only maintenance policy on specific tables, never a general cross-tenant runtime role
remediations.tenant-client: use prisma.tenant(tenantKey) where the tenant is already known
remediations.explicit-tenant-argument: request-scoped call that relies on the implicit request tenant: pass the tenant explicitly
remediations.split: part stays, part moves to the tenant client
